releaseNotes: Dropify 2.0.2 — Dedicated Settings Page, Theme Selector Modal, Smart Same-Vibe Radio & Launch Auto-Updates
Dedicated Full-Screen Settings Page: Clean full-page settings hub with smooth slide navigation, hardware back gesture support, and organized system diagnostics
Tactile 4-Mode Theme Selector: Instant switching between Dark Mode (#141414), AMOLED Matte (#000000 true pitch black), Light Paper (#FAF7F2), and System Theme
Launch Update Auto-Popup: Dropify now automatically detects updates in the background on every app launch and notifies you immediately without 24h delays
Smart Same-Vibe Radio: Search results (e.g. Alfaaz) no longer play 10 copies of the same song from different channels—auto-generates a 50-track same-vibe radio stream!
ExoPlayer Stream Cache Manager: Inspect real-time cached streaming size in MB and clear temporary audio stream files with a single tap, keeping offline tracks 100% safe
Audio Streaming Quality & Bluetooth Sync: High (160kbps Opus), Standard (128kbps), Data Saver (64kbps), and Bluetooth latency offset calibration (-250ms to +250ms)
Pure 2D Neobrutalism: 100% 2D tactile design, zero liquid glass clutter, 1:1 in-card video/music toggle, ambient lighting glow, and lyrics romanization
Frameless desktop experience with Mica material
System Tray integration with quick controls
Windows Taskbar thumbnail toolbar (Thumbar buttons: Play/Pause, Next, Prev)
Global Media Key support (MediaPlayPause, Next, Prev)
Discord Rich Presence showing current song and live progress
10-band DSP Graphic Equalizer with AutoEq presets
